Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

Witness Statement of CHEUNG Lok-hang  

I, CHEUNG Lok-hang, of Tai Po Fire Station, New Territories North Command, Fire Services Department, 3 Ting Kok Road, Tai Po, N.T., do say as follows:-  

1.  
I am the Station Commander of Tai Po Fire Station, of the Fire Services Department (“FSD”) of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. I have joined the FSD for 15 years and 4 months since 4 October 2010 and was promoted to the present rank of Assistant Divisional Officer on 31 December 2023. My main responsibility is to oversee the operation and administration of the Tai Po Fire Station.  

2.  
I make this Witness Statement pursuant to Request 4 of the Independent Committee (“Committee”) in relation to the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po as set out in a letter from Messrs. Lo & Lo, Solicitors for the Committee, to the FSD dated 4 February 2026 (“4 February Letter”) in which specific questions were raised in paragraphs 1 to 10 and 16 (“Questions”). Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief. Save as otherwise specified, this Witness Statement adopts the same abbreviations and nomenclature as in the 4 February Letter.
